[E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
==========================================================================
MappingDocumentController
  | runtime CanvasEditingContext {contextId}
  v
DefaultCanvasHistoryService
  WeakMap<object handle, CanvasHistory>
  openContext(document, view, history?) -> frozen handle
  same persisted context may have isolated viewer handles
  |
  +-- state -> checkpointId / document / view / canUndo / canRedo
  +-- document -> resolved canvas document
  +-- resolve(diagramId) -> DiagramView in this context
  +-- append(document, view, correspondence?) -> history.append
  +-- navigate(redo?) / reset
  +-- exportContext / forkContext / adopt
  +-- persistenceChanges(since?) / retireTransactions
  +-- prepareTransfer / transferBoundary / prepareTransferNavigation
  |
  v
Canvas checkpoint + diagram revisions move together
  controller.canvasRevisionId = history head checkpoint ID
  diagram.revisionId -> DiagramService-issued content revision
  append carries old->new content-node correspondence
  ordinary undo -> history.navigate -> document + view restored
  linked transfer -> navigate throws; use workspace undo/redo
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
MappingPage: copy/move between canvases
  capture source canvasRevisionId + selected diagram IDs
  pause persistence; reject changed source or busy participants
  capture workspace + source/destination histories
  runWorkspaceTask(type: transfer)
       |
       v
  prepared source + destination states + CanvasTransfer transaction
    move: install prepared source document/history/view
    copy: retain source document, clear source selection
    destination: prepared document/history/view; create if needed
    workspace: active destination + transfer ledger
       |
       v
publishTransfer -> storage.save(workspace)
  flush existing writes -> project snapshot -> records.commit(changes)
  both histories + workspace transaction persisted together
       |
       | acknowledgement
       v
installWorkspace -> sessions + transfers + activeId + fresh view state
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Workspace undo/redo at a transfer boundary
  require both controllers; undo newer overlapping transfers first
  prepareTransferNavigation(source, destination, transaction, redo)
  replace both participant histories/documents/views
  undo newly created destination -> hidden; redo -> visible
  persist -> acknowledge -> install; active source on undo
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
WorkspacePersistence -> RecordStorage -> WorkspaceStorage worker
  per-session sequence cursor -> incremental history records
  metadata / baseline / revision / checkpoint / canvas / viewport
  workspace index = document IDs + active document + transfers
  RecordStorage: cache + pending-by-key -> one in-flight batch
  requestId + expectedRevision; ambiguous response -> retry same batch
  definitive REJECTED during commit -> rollback cache, discard flight
Sources: canvasHistoryService.ts; MappingPage.tsx;
workspacePersistence.ts; recordStorage.ts; workspaceStorage.ts
